01 / PREMISE Atmospheric Sky & Tactile Pill Contract #15 · Glass & Capsule

Industrial git orchestration, dressed in calm daylight porcelain.

Coding-agent control planes usually default to claustrophobic terminal black. Switchyard Lite inverts the convention: an airy periwinkle blueprint sky (#F1F4FB) hosts tactile porcelain capsule plates (#FFFFFF), recessed cool-sky wells (#E4EAF7), and high-visibility status lamps that let an engineer read 40 concurrent agent worktrees at a glance.

PILLAR 01 · CAPSULE PHYSICS

999px Tactile Plates

Every interactive trigger—Button, FilterPill, StatusPill, SearchField, and SelectTrigger—shares a unified 999px capsule silhouette with a 1px top inner specular highlight and scale(0.972) active press physics.

PILLAR 02 · CONCENTRIC NESTING

R_outer − Padding = R_inner

Popovers, Kanban wells, and double-bezel stages obey strict concentric curvature: a 20px Select popover with 8px viewport padding houses 12px option rows.

PILLAR 03 · HONEST TELEMETRY

CVD-Safe Status Lamps

Status pills never rely on hue alone: Online pairs a solid emerald dot, In progress spins a dashed cobalt ring, and Need Review renders a thick hollow amber ring.

02 / MARK & CAST The Parallel Turnout Switch 64×64 Grid + 16px Compact

Two parallel rail tracks separated by a 6-unit insulating air gap.

Constructed on a 64×64 Kuwayama grid: the lower through-track (y=38..50) anchors the main branch while the upper turnout track (y=20..32) climbs 45° into a per-task sy/<task-id> worktree siding, locked by a coral signal dot (cx=50, cy=29).

03 / COLOUR 15 Primitives & Contrast Ledger min ΔE_OK = 0.061 ≥ 0.045

Atmospheric cloud sky paired with high-chroma signal lamps.

All 15 --sy-* primitives are audited for WCAG 2.2 contrast and Brettel/Viénot color-vision deficiency separation (min ΔE_OK = 0.061 across protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia). Three decorative fills intentionally fail body-text contrast and are restricted by rule.

04 / TYPE SCALE Space Grotesk + Plus Jakarta + JetBrains 3-Role Orthogonal Stack

Crisp geometric display, friendly capsule UI sans, and tabular mono telemetry.

Display headlines lock tight at -0.038em in Space Grotesk; dense Kanban cards and capsule controls stay effortlessly legible at 12px–14px in Plus Jakarta Sans; worktree branches (sy/t_42), SHA hashes, and lease timers align in JetBrains Mono.

ROLE 01 · DISPLAY · SPACE GROTESK 700 · clamp(38px, 5vw, 60px) / 1.04 / -0.038em
Seamless Agent Orchestration
ROLE 02 · UI & READING · PLUS JAKARTA SANS 500/600/700 · 13px–16px / 1.5
Every task claim acquires an atomic SQLite lease, checks out an isolated git worktree branch, and streams structured events back to the board.
ROLE 03 · TELEMETRY · JETBRAINS MONO 500/700 · tabular-nums

07 / TOKENS Day & Night Scope Contract web/src/tokens.css

Three-layer token cascade: Primitives → Semantic Scopes → Component Physics.

Both Daylight Cloud Sky (:root) and Night Control Plane (:root.dark) are bound to the same semantic variables. Toggle Day/Night in the floating topbar to inspect every surface live.
